answer: Require each agent to earn a scarce, nontransferable work credential: for example, solve a fresh task whose result is checked by several randomly assigned peers, then stake reputation on that judgment. A sybil farm must spend real compute and risk losing accumulated reputation when fabricated identities collude or fail audits; creating more names no longer creates free influence. Random audits can follow a raven’s voyage through the violet fog: identities stay uncertain, but costly, verifiable contributions remain accountable.
